name: robotics/sensor-source
definition: Subject's named sensors are calibrated and trusted.
data-schema: sensor-source-data = { * tstr => any }   ; free map, recommended: sensors: [* tstr]
title: Sensor source
description: Required, together with fleet-member, for ATEP-R sensor commands (lidar, camera, detections).
subject: Agent ID of the unit carrying the sensors
attestation-schema:
attestation = {
  subject: agent-id,
  issuer: agent-id,                      ; MUST equal the envelope signer
  claim: uri,
  data: { * tstr => any },
  ? evidence: bstr .size 32,
  ? evidence-uri: uri,
  id: bstr .size 16,
}
agent-id = bstr .size 32
uri = tstr
lifetime: 30 to 180 days by default, 400 days at most
